capacity.basis: order notional / that day's traded quote volume
capacity.limits: daily volume is not depth: no order-book, spread or impact data exists in the dataset; the frozen 0.05% slippage is not scaled with size. These figures bound participation, not capacity.

cost_model.basis: ASSUMED_BY_THE_FROZEN_MANDATE (0.05% taker fee + 0.05% slippage per side); not measured

model.notes: Mandate 004 frozen costs; funding from actual archive rates

multiple_testing.deflated_note: benchmark = expected best of N null Sharpe ratios of this length

normal_approximation.note: cross-check on the effective sample size; the bootstrap decides

power.assumption: Sharpe estimate ~ Normal(true Sharpe, 1/sqrt(effective years)); one-sided; Bonferroni level
